name: Slim Business Laptop Backpack | Lightweight Travel & Office Bag with Multi-Pockets | Navy Blue

Key Features:
 Durable & water-resistant polyester fabric
 Slim, lightweight design with a professional look

Material:
Water-Resistant Polyester Fabric, Reinforced Zippers
